scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.check: npm run validate:repo && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit && biome check .
scripts.test: vitest run && node electron/test_card_kdf.mjs && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s electron -p 'test_*.py' && bash scripts/host/test-ipi-browser-guard.sh
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node scripts/package-linux.mjs && node scripts/release-manifest.mjs
